description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing authentication state in a frontend application, including functions for bootstrap, login, and logout, interacting with an API client.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes authentication state by fetching session info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login by calling an API and updating the store.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and resets the authentication state.
